verdict.rationale: The evidence has no documented retention settings, retention periods, or deletion controls in Hightouch. The warehouse-native claim that Hightouch does not copy data is an architectural property. It leaves retention to the customer's own warehouse, which is a host-platform capability and not a Hightouch feature. CDC sending removed rows and data contracts are adjacent sync and collection behaviors, not retention or deletion controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
